english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a burden or something that has to be carried.
Use this when the imposition is mainly a burden or obligation that someone has to carry.
This is the all-purpose choice when the load is a burden on someone, whether physical or a worry.
This is the all-purpose choice for a physical, practical, or emotional burden.
Use this for a burdensome demand or strain on something such as time or health.

examples.english: Looking after two elderly people is a big encumbrance for me.
examples.traditional: 照顧兩個老人家對我嚟講係好大嘅負擔。

examples.jyutping: jiu3 jat1 go3 jan4 ziu3 gu3 sing4 gaa1 jan4 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 ge3 fu6 daam1
